# FINDINGS — M2.7 battery 2

This file merges and deduplicates three sources:

- the **judges' causes** in [`scores.json`](./scores.json): 222 causes on 66 pages (179 `webkit`, 28 `builder`, 15 `harness`). The judges verified each `webkit` cause in the package source the builders used;
- the **18 builder journals** in [`journals/`](./journals/), including frictions that a screenshot cannot show (setup, types, lint, docs);
- the orchestrator's notes taken during the run (findings not yet owned by a fix lane, harness problems, pre-existing test failures).

**Ranking.** Impact = the sum over affected pages of the severity weight (high 3, medium 2, low 1; the highest severity per page counts). *Pages* are the pages whose judge named the cause. For shared chrome (`SiteNav`, `SiteFooter`, `SearchTrigger`) some judges listed it once per batch rather than on every page, so the count is a lower bound: the defect is in the shared component and every page that uses it shows it.

**Builders** are the jobs whose journal or `DONE.md` reports the friction (journals are in `journals/<JOB>.md`). Builder S1 built `site-home`, `site-pricing`, `site-contact`, `site-solution-web-apps`; see [SCORES.md](./SCORES.md) for the page→job map.

**Status** is `open` for every row; the orchestrator fills in the fix lane and the commit.

## B. WebKit causes the builders reported that the screenshots do not show

## C. Builder-cause patterns (repeated misses that point at missing guidance)

The judges marked 28 causes as `builder`: WebKit had what was needed and the builder did not use it. When several builders miss the same thing, the guidance failed.

| -- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| P1 | **Quote band with too few clients or one-ink logos.** Single-item `QuoteTabs` instead of `ClientQuotes`, clients dropped although their marks exist (GPA, GFG), or one-ink `mark`s where `ClientQuotesItem.logo` takes the shipped `*-extended-color.svg`. Partly forced by B2-03 (autoplay) and B2-07 (logo URLs).                         | `site-contact`, `site-solution-web-apps`, `site-solution-financial-services`, `site-professional-services`, `site-product-kv-store`, `site-product-object-storage`, `site-product-web-application-firewall`, `site-product-secure-internet-access`, `site-product-ai-gateway`, `site-product-data-stream` (10) | S1, S1c, S2c, S3b, S4b      | `ClientQuotes` docs: a quote band always shows the full client wall; give the default client set with colour logos as a copyable example.                               |

## D. Harness notes

| #  | Note                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| -- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| H1 | **Fonts fall back on both sides.** Rubik returns 404 from `fonts.azion.com` (ROADMAP M2.10 row 13), so references and rebuilds render a fallback face; the judges did not deduct font differences. Several builders read the fallback as a theme mismatch with the site's heading face (S1, S1b, S4a); one traced part of it to the nested theme 4 copy (T4).                                                                                                                                       |
| H2 | **`ClientQuotes` autoplay timing.** `QuoteTabs` advances every 5000 ms and `ClientQuotes` cannot stop it (B2-03). The capture waits 2.5 s and then scrolls the page, so the quote on screen depends on timing (usually Axur, the second). The judges did not deduct the visible quote (marked `harness` on 7 pages), but did deduct where builders dropped clients to work around it. Once B2-03 lands, the capture can freeze the band.                                                         |
| H3 | **`run-job.sh` exit 127 is an artifact.** Nine jobs (S3a–c, S4a–c, C2a–c) recorded exit 127 with `run-job.sh: line 16: dd-dir: command not found`: the copy of the script used for that wave had the `--add-dir` flag broken across a line, so the builder session ran without it and the stray word failed afterwards, overriding the exit code. All 18 sessions ended with a `success` result and wrote `DONE.md`. The copy in [`harness/run-job.sh`](./harness/run-job.sh.txt) is the corrected script. |
| H4 | **Job split.** `mkjobs.mjs` first cut six jobs (S1–S4 of 11–12 site pages, C1–C2 of 10 console screens). To finish sooner they were split into 18 jobs of 2–4 pages: S1, S2 and C1 kept their first 3–4 pages, the rest went to S1b/S1c, S2b/S2c, C1b/C1c, and S3, S4 and C2 became empty parents of S3a–c, S4a–c and C2a–c. Each builder ran once (8–21 minutes, 61–132 turns).                                                                                                                  |
| H5 | **Package contamination.** The packed tarball shipped `docs/reviews/` (T14). S1b and S4c read the battery-2 kit's `structure/*.txt` (the component trees of the reference pages, with internal block names) and used them as a section map for their pages; the kit's evaluator `pages.json` with the `▸` hints was also in the tarball, and S1b listed it, but the session logs show no read of its contents. S1, S1c, S2, S4a and C2c read run-1 journals or findings. S1b's and S4c's pages (means 3.75 and 4.12) may be slightly favoured. |
| H6 | **Data noise.** Frozen marquee and ticker offsets; external photos (Slack avatar URLs in `table-view`, author photos) replaced by initials so the apps make no runtime network calls; relative timestamps drift with the capture clock; no reference article art or office photos for the blog, resource hub and careers pages. None was deducted.                                                                                                                                                  |
| H7 | **Brief truncation.** In `pages.eval.json` some structure trees end with "full tree in structure/…txt", a file the job folder did not have (S1, S1c); the `site-pricing` comparison-table tree drops repeated cells and does not mark group headers, and the builder transcribed it literally (the missing "Workloads" sub-group header and the Savings Plan row).                                                                                                                                    |
| H8 | **Packing.** `pnpm pack` in `packages/webkit` (pnpm 11.9) exits 254 because `postpack` (`copy-ai-bundle --clean`) removes `adapters/` before pnpm finishes; the tarball is complete (4,545 entries). Pre-existing test failures at the base commit (Chromium, 23,737 tests): `hydration-node.test.ts` (`blocks/platform/account/tokens` and its `created` variant) and `screen-reader.test.ts` (overlays › Command).                                                                                  |
